quotes: XRD analysis revealed that uncalcined soil primarily consisted of 42.1 % quartz (SiO2) and 57.9 % kaolinite (Al2Si2O5(OH)4)
whereas the calcined soil contained 47.1 % quartz and 52.9 % amorphous phases
determined using zinc oxide (ZnO) as an internal standard with a ZnO-to-soil mass ratio of 1:4
rationale: Phase statements describe soil; ZnO is separately an internal standard. Each reported soil composition sums to 100. No phase values are recomputed.
scope: source interpretation only, not full corpus acceptance
